sentences.text: You are nine years old, a prince in Kaifeng, and before you eat a single bite, a servant tastes it in case it kills you.
But poison is not what will break you.
You live in Kaifeng, the capital of the Song Empire, on the plains of central China, just south of the Yellow River.
Today it is a city in China's Henan province.
The Song dynasty is only nine years old.
Every morning starts the same way.
The eunuch lifts your rice porridge to his own lips, swallows, and waits.
Everyone in the room watches his face.
If he turns pale, the cook dies.
Because the woman kneeling by the door taught you to.
She is the same woman who tasted the milk nine years ago.
The palace calls her your nurse.
You call her something else, but only when no one is listening.
